findings.reason: Verified that every property of the appStore object literal is a bare `import()` expression, so all 28 app modules start loading as soon as the module is evaluated. The change only adds `await` everywhere and defers nothing; the fix of using thunks is correct, but this is a design/perf point rather than a functional break.

Verified that in vital/wipemycalother reschedule.ts the `forEach(async …)` callback discards its promise. A synchronous throw from `new CalendarService(credential)` inside the now-async `getCalendar` used to reach the surrounding try/catch, and now it becomes an unhandled rejection. The regression is real but narrow, since the deletes were already fire-and-forget.
